steps.title: Start a session in one tap
steps.text: Tap New Session and you’re in. Add students as they arrive: 1 or 2 initials and up to 5 goals each, up to 6 students per session.

steps.title: One tap per trial
steps.text: Big Correct, Prompted and Incorrect buttons for every goal. The percentage updates with each tap, and Undo takes back a slip.

steps.title: Track prompt levels as you go
steps.text: Tap Prompted, pick the main prompt (Visual, Verbal, Physical or your own), then Correct or Incorrect. Only correct on their own counts toward accuracy.

steps.title: Your data sheet, minus the math
steps.text: Accuracy, counts and a prompt breakdown for every goal, ready to copy onto your paper data sheet. Or share it as text or PDF, or print it.

steps.title: End & Clear. Nothing kept.
steps.text: When you’re done, End & Clear erases the whole session from the device after an “Are you sure?”. No history, no cloud copy.

video_steps: Start a session in one tap
calc_intro: How long does tallying and percentage math take you after each group? Put in your numbers. This is your estimate, not a promise from us.
calc_minutes_label: Minutes per session on tallying and percentage math
calc_minutes_hint: Counting marks, dividing, rounding, filling in the data sheet.
calc_invalid: Enter numbers of 0 or more to see an estimate.
calc_math: Math: sessions × minutes × 5 days a week, and sessions × minutes × 180 days ÷ 60. Based only on what you enter.
privacy_title: No accounts. No cloud. Nothing kept.

privacy_items.title: Initials only
privacy_items.text: Students are identified by 1 or 2 initials. No names, birthdays or ID numbers.

privacy_items.title: Stays on your device
privacy_items.text: Session data never leaves your iPhone or iPad unless you choose to share a summary, and it’s left out of iCloud backups.

privacy_items.title: Erased with End & Clear
privacy_items.text: One tap, after “Are you sure?”, permanently erases the session. There’s no history to leak.

privacy_items.title: No tracking
privacy_items.text: No analytics, no ads, no third-party code. The App Store privacy label says Data Not Collected. This website has no cookies or trackers either.

privacy_items.title: Nothing for your district to vet on our side
privacy_items.text: No sign-up, no servers, no student records with us. When you share a summary, follow your district’s rules for where it goes.

maker_text: Trial&Tally was built with a practicing school speech-language pathologist, for the way school sessions really run: groups that change by the minute, students who arrive late, and a paper data sheet that still needs filling in. It was shaped by testing in real sessions.

faq_items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
faq_items.a: You can’t start new sessions until you unlock. A session that’s already open can keep recording until midnight that day, and after that you can still view, share and clear it. You never lose data you’ve already recorded.
No. Sessions work fully offline. You only need a connection to start the free trial, buy or restore the unlock, and open the support and rating links.

faq_items.q: Can I change the prompt types and button labels?
faq_items.a: Yes. In Settings you can rename, add, reorder and delete prompt types, and rename the Correct, Prompted and Incorrect buttons.
